instruction_control.method: hipEvent microbenchmark, 160x64 threads, 2M dependent wmma i32_16x16x16 instructions per lane path, identical instruction counts for iu8 and iu4

precision_matched_split_verdict.arithmetic: 2 iu4 products per iu8 product at 1.892x rate = 0.945x
precision_matched_split_verdict.verdict: REJECTED as a speed route: the exact integer split q8 = low4 + 16*high4 loses ~5% on arithmetic alone, before recombination/correction overhead

residual_iu4_fewer_plane_verdict.arithmetic_ceiling: 2 iu4 planes vs 3 iu8 planes = 1.06x ceiling
residual_iu4_fewer_plane_verdict.verdict: REJECTED per the R8 stop criteria: a <=6% arithmetic ceiling on the expert-GEMV subowner cannot fund the numerical risk (4-bit residual planes vs 8-bit; the Q5_K precedent shows the BF16-publication envelope sits within 18% of rejection at 8-bit-adjacent precision) or the qualification cost

stop_rule: Advance only a complete-chain win; the measured instruction-level control consumes the gain, so the bounded screen closes without a kernel build
